title: Uniqueness of the blow-up for some Alt-Phillips cones
summary: We establish uniqueness of blow-ups, with sharp quantitative convergence, for several classes of singular minimizing cones in the Alt-Phillips problem, in the range $γ\in(0,2)$. As a consequence, we obtain uniqueness at every free boundary point in dimensions $d=2,3,4$ for $γ\in(1,2)$, and in dimensions $d\geq 5$ for $γ\in\left(1,\frac32\right)$. The proof of uniqueness is based on three new logarithmic epiperimetric inequalities.
